scholarships_add.name: Kathmandu Metropolitan City Class 11 and 12 Scholarship
scholarships_add.covers: Free Class 11 and 12 seats in the institutional schools of Kathmandu Metropolitan City, in Science, Management, Humanities, Education or Law. Each school must give 5 percent of seats (up to 500 students), 12 percent (500 to 800) or 15 percent (over 800).
scholarships_add.who: SEE graduates of 2082 who studied in a community school anywhere in Nepal, live permanently in Kathmandu Metropolitan City, live in the landfill affected wards (Kakani 1 to 3 in Nuwakot, Dhunibesi 1, 3 and 4 in Dhading) or finished Class 10 in an institutional school. Seats split 35 percent community school, 10 percent institutional school, 19 percent city residents and 1 percent landfill area, and the remaining 35 percent is reserved (women 33, Janajati 15, Khas Arya 17, Madhesi 12, Dalit 9, Tharu 4, backward districts 4, disability 2, Muslim 2, martyr and conflict families 2).
scholarships_add.how: Free online form on entrance.kathmandu.gov.np (2083: Jestha 1 to 10). One subject and a priority list of schools. A 100 question OMR exam on the Class 10 syllabus (maths 30, science 30, social 20, English 10, Nepali 10, two hours, pass mark 40 percent, no negative marking) was held on Jestha 17, then merit lists place you subject and school wise. Take admission only after the result; a school need not refund a fee you already paid. Helpline 16600105511 or 1180. A wrap-up round reopened in June 2026 for 1,576 vacant seats (collegenp headline).

scholarships_add.name: KU Provincial Government Scholarships (one seat per programme)
scholarships_add.covers: Full tuition (nothing else) for a bachelor programme at Kathmandu University, one student per listed programme and province (the Madhesh 2083 list has 6 seats, so awards counts one province). Bagmati also ran a technical scholarship for 2082/83 (MBBS, BAMS, veterinary, agriculture, civil and IT engineering, nursing; closed Ashadh 10, 2083, nebgpacalculator.com). The Madhesh 2083 list: BE Mining, BE Chemical, BE Environmental, Bachelor in Health Informatics, BSc Environmental Science and BSc Agriculture.
scholarships_add.who: Permanent residents of the province who passed Class 12 (Madhesh: Science only). Marks out of 100 in Madhesh: GPA up to 60, local level recommendation for hardship 10, community school 3 against institutional 2 each for SEE and Class 12 (up to 10 in all), and an interview worth 20 marks from a three member committee.
scholarships_add.how: Each province publishes its own notice in July (2083: Madhesh 2 to 22 July, Bagmati 2 to 16 July, Gandaki 10 to 30 July, Koshi 13 to 23 July, Lumbini 15 to 28 July; Karnali and Sudurpaschim also appear on Edusanjal). Apply on paper to the provincial Ministry of Education or Social Development with self attested copies of citizenship, marksheets, a local recommendation and a school type declaration.

scholarships_add.name: Ncell SEE Scholarship (Ncell Foundation with Project Shikshya)
scholarships_add.covers: Support for Class 11 and 12 for 100 SEE graduates (Project Shikshya adds 50 more), plus 12 months of free data and voice from Ncell.
scholarships_add.who: SEE graduates of 2082 who need financial support, picked for talent and need in all seven provinces.
scholarships_add.how: Announced on 19 May 2026 (Techpana, Nepali Telecom). Written exams and interviews in all seven provinces. The foundation gave 50 scholarships the year before.

scholarships_add.name: Far Western University BSc CSIT and BBA scholarship seats
scholarships_add.covers: Scholarship seats equal to 10 percent of the approved seats of BSc CSIT and BBA at its affiliated campuses.
scholarships_add.who: Eligible Nepali students applying for those programmes at FWU affiliated campuses.
scholarships_add.how: Apply on fwu.edu.np/scholarship. In 2083 the exam moved from 2083/05/03 to 2083/05/14 and the form deadline to 2083/05/13 because few students had applied against the quota (notice of 2083/05/02, collegenp).

scholarships_add.name: Nepal Open University scholarships (Management and Law)
scholarships_add.covers: Scholarships for students in MBA, MS in Development Management and Governance, BBS and LL.B.
scholarships_add.who: Students enrolled in those programmes across the university batches.
scholarships_add.how: The 2083 form ran from Asar 12 to Asar 32 (26 June to 16 July 2026) on the NOU Student Panel (Educatenepal, 26 June 2026).

scholarships_add.name: HELP Bachelor Scholarship (Helambu Education and Livelihood Partnership)
scholarships_add.covers: NPR 550,000 over 4 to 5 years of bachelor study in Nepal (nebgpacalculator figure; HELP prints no total).
scholarships_add.who: Past HELP SEE scholars who finished +2 with at least GPA 2.8 in the major subjects (maths, physics and chemistry for engineering), with leadership and a promise to serve Nepal. Two students a year, preferably one boy and one girl.
scholarships_add.how: Online form on help.org.np, usually from October, then a written test and an interview. HELP also funds SEE scholarships for government school graduates with GPA 2.8 (science) or 2.4 (management), has helped over 600 students and gave 72 in its latest round.

scholarships_add.name: Municipal Class 11 scholarships (Pokhara, Biratnagar, Tokha, Madhyapur Thimi, Bharatpur, Itahari, Dhangadhi)
scholarships_add.covers: Free Class 11 and 12 seats in institutional schools (Bharatpur also community campuses) inside the city, filled by an entrance exam. No city notice prints a seat count; the awards figure is left out on purpose and the card shows Open call.
scholarships_add.who: SEE graduates with Nepali citizenship; each city adds its own rules. Madhyapur Thimi asks at least GPA 1.6 and a community or institutional school SEE, with a birth, citizenship or residence certificate for residents.
scholarships_add.how: 2083/84 notices (Educatenepal, May 2026). Pokhara: paper form to the Education Administration Division, Pokhara-17 Damside, 13 to 20 May. Biratnagar: online at scholarship.biratnagarmun.gov.np, form 1 to 10 Jestha, exam 17 Jestha. Tokha: scholarship.tokhamun.gov.np, form 1 to 15 Jestha, exam 23 Jestha (science 30, English 30, maths 30, general knowledge 10 percent). Madhyapur Thimi: form 1 to 10 Jestha, exam 16 Jestha. Bharatpur: scholarship.bharatpurmun.gov.np, form 8 to 22 Jestha. Itahari and Dhangadhi: window 13 May to 2 June and 15 May to 29 July on Edusanjal. Apply to every city you qualify for, and take admission only after the result.

scholarships_add.name: Department of IT scholarship for IT students (NPR 50,000)
scholarships_add.by: Ministry of Communication and Information Technology, Department of Information Technology
scholarships_add.covers: A one time lump sum of NPR 50,000 per selected student, on a quota the department sets (no number is printed in the notice).
scholarships_add.who: Students enrolled in information technology at the bachelor, master, M.Phil. or PhD level in a Nepali university or its constituent or affiliated institution, with a letter from the college saying you get no other scholarship. Government or community school SEE and economic hardship letters from the local level count.
scholarships_add.how: Under the Scholarship Procedure for IT Students 2081. The 2082 call ran from Baisakh 29 to Jestha 12, 2082 (12 to 26 May 2025): a paper application at the department in Tinkune, Kathmandu, or scanned documents to scholarship@doit.gov.np (phone 01-4112334). Watch doit.gov.np around May for the next call.

scholarships_add.name: Nepal Army Welfare Scholarship (domestic)
scholarships_add.covers: NPR 25,000 a year per student for Class 4 to 12.
scholarships_add.who: One son or daughter of a serving or retired Nepali Army soldier, aged at most 21, who passed in the 2082 session with at least 40 percent (GPA 1.6) in a community school or 50 percent (GPA 2.0) in an institutional school. Students at schools outside Nepal and children of soldiers dismissed without welfare benefits are not eligible; a Class 12 grant is given once per couple.
scholarships_add.how: The 2082 call (collegenp.com and Edusanjal) was open from 26 August to 17 October 2026. Send the form and marksheets through the Army welfare channels named in the notice. The 2077 notice paid NPR 20,000, so the amount has risen.

s-pu-scholarship.how: Apply online at scholarship.pu.edu.np. The 2083 notice ran from 2083/02/26 to 2083/03/14 (9 to 28 June 2026) with a 3 hour written exam on the central campus at Dhungepatan, Pokhara, held on 2083/03/20 and 21. The notice lists 1,381 quotas: Science and Technology 558 (BE Civil 183, BE Computer 107, BCA 65, BE IT 53, B.Arch 39, BE Software 29, BICE 15 and others), Management 777 (BBA 419, BBA Finance 104, BCSIT 94, BHM 115, BHCM 40, BTTM 5) and Humanities 46. A different guide, nebgpacalculator.com, prints 1,328 seats with 60 percent open merit; the notice total is used here. 80 percent of seats go to community school SEE graduates and 20 percent to institutional schools.

s-ctevt.covers: Free (classified) seats in diploma and PCL programmes at constituent, partnership and private institutes: 3,417 seats in 34 programmes for 2083/84, half for the general group and half for target groups. Seats by province: Bagmati 838, Madhesh 670, Koshi 609, Lumbini 604, Gandaki 264, Sudurpashchim 222, Karnali 210. Nursing is 189 seats and Civil Engineering 640 (Koshi 144, Madhesh 108, Lumbini 108, Bagmati 100, Gandaki 60, Karnali 60, Sudurpashchim 60).

faq_add.q: How do I get a free Class 11 and 12 seat in Kathmandu Metropolitan City?
faq_add.a: Kathmandu Metropolitan City runs a scholarship exam for SEE graduates who want a free seat in an institutional school inside the city (notice for 2083, entrance.kathmandu.gov.np). The form was open from Jestha 1 to 10 and was free. You pick one subject (Science, Management, Humanities, Education or Law) and rank every school you would accept. The exam has 100 multiple choice questions on the Class 10 syllabus (maths 30, science 30, social 20, English 10, Nepali 10) in two hours, with a 40 percent pass mark and no negative marking. Seats are filled by merit: 35 percent community school students, 10 percent institutional school students, 19 percent city residents and 1 percent landfill area residents, and the rest is reserved for women, Janajati, Khas Arya, Madhesi, Dalit and other groups. Do not take admission anywhere before the result, because schools need not refund an earlier fee. Helpline 16600105511 or 1180.

faq_add.q: Is there a provincial government scholarship for Kathmandu University?
faq_add.a: Yes. Each province gives Kathmandu University tuition scholarships to its own residents, one student per programme, in July. The 2083 windows were Madhesh 2 to 22 July, Bagmati 2 to 16 July, Gandaki 10 to 30 July, Koshi 13 to 23 July and Lumbini 15 to 28 July (Edusanjal). The Madhesh list had six programmes: BE Mining, Chemical and Environmental Engineering, Health Informatics, BSc Environmental Science and BSc Agriculture, only for Science +2 graduates. Marks out of 100: GPA up to 60, hardship letter 10, community school up to 10, interview 20. It pays tuition only, so budget for the other fees. Watch the notice of your own province every June and July.

faq_add.q: What can I study at Mid-West University in Surkhet and its campuses?
faq_add.a: The 2083/84 bachelor admission notice (as printed on collegenp.com, 19 Nov 2026) lists: BA in English, International Relations, Journalism, Mathematics, Nepali, Sociology, Social Work, Economics and Rural Development; BBS; B.Ed. in seven subjects; BSc CSIT, BIT, BSc Environment and BSc biology and physical groups; BE Computer, Civil and Hydropower at Sano Surkhet; BSc Agriculture at Ramghat; and BA LL.B. Ten constituent campuses teach mostly BBS, B.Ed. and BA: Babai (Gulariya), Bageshwari (Kohalpur, with BSc and BBA), Bheri Gyanodaya (Jajarkot), Bheri (Gumi, Surkhet), Jaljala (Rolpa), Musikot Khalanga (Rukum), Narayan (Dailekh), Rara (Mugu), Tila Karnali (Kalikot) and Vidhyapur Janata (Surkhet). Rara and Tila Karnali list B.Ed. only. Global College International in Mid-Baneshwor, Kathmandu is the one affiliated college and runs BBA, BHM and BTTM. The notice gives phone numbers but no seats or fees.

faq_add.q: How many Pokhara University scholarship seats were there in 2083 and how do I apply?
faq_add.a: The Pokhara University notice for 2083 lists 1,381 quotas: Science and Technology 558 (BE Civil 183, BE Computer 107, BCA 65, BE IT 53, B.Arch 39, BE Software 29, BICE 15), Management 777 (BBA 419, BBA Finance 104, BCSIT 94, BHM 115, BHCM 40, BTTM 5) and Humanities 46. The form ran from 9 to 28 June 2026 on scholarship.pu.edu.np and the 3 hour written exam was held in Pokhara. Another guide prints 1,328 seats; the notice figure is used here. 80 percent of seats go to community school SEE graduates. A scholarship waives tuition at the constituent or affiliated college you are placed in, so keep the grades the renewal rule asks for.

faq_add.q: How many free CTEVT diploma seats does each province have?
faq_add.a: The CTEVT classified scholarship notice for 2083/84 lists 3,417 seats in 34 programmes (collegenp.com, Edusanjal): Bagmati 838, Madhesh 670, Koshi 609, Lumbini 604, Gandaki 264, Sudurpashchim 222 and Karnali 210. Civil Engineering alone has 640 seats and Nursing 189. Half the seats are for the general group and half for women, Dalit, Janajati, Khas Arya, Madhesi, Tharu, Muslim, remote area, disability and martyr family groups. You file one programme in one province, so pick the province where your SEE school is or where the seats are widest. Recipients agree to serve where the government posts them, and you cannot apply twice.

faq_add.q: Which private or NGO scholarships can I try after SEE?
faq_add.a: The Ncell SEE Scholarship supports 100 SEE graduates of 2082 through Class 11 and 12, with 12 months of free data and voice, and Project Shikshya adds 50 more. Candidates sit written exams and interviews in all seven provinces (announced 19 May 2026). HELP (Helambu Education and Livelihood Partnership) funds government school graduates with GPA 2.8 in science or 2.4 in management and has helped over 600 students; its bachelor scholarship is open only to former HELP scholars and pays NPR 550,000 over the course (a guide figure) for two students a year. Never pay an agent for a scholarship place: real programmes do not charge to apply.

faq_add.q: How did you check the college websites you added?
faq_add.a: A script built candidate addresses from each college name, kept only those that answer over valid HTTPS, and accepted a page only when its title or first screen names the college and the page mentions the district or town. A person then read each result: 43 colleges got a website in wave 30, while pages for sale, ministry or hospital sites with similar names, shared sites for two colleges and a placeholder page were rejected. A name match is still not proof, so confirm the college and its affiliation with the university before you pay a fee.

faq_add.q: Are there scholarships at Far Western University and Nepal Open University?
faq_add.a: Far Western University keeps scholarship seats equal to 10 percent of the approved seats of BSc CSIT and BBA at its affiliated campuses. In 2083 the exam moved to 2083/05/14 and the form deadline to 2083/05/13 because too few students had applied (notice of 2083/05/02, fwu.edu.np/scholarship). Nepal Open University took scholarship forms for MBA, MS in Development Management and Governance, BBS and LL.B. from 26 June to 16 July 2026 on its Student Panel. Dates change every year, so check the university notice board in Asar and Shrawan.

faq_add.q: Which cities give free Class 11 scholarships and when do forms open?
faq_add.a: Seven city notices for 2083/84 were published in May 2026 (Educatenepal, Edusanjal): Kathmandu (form 1 to 10 Jestha, exam 17 Jestha), Biratnagar (form 1 to 10 Jestha, exam 17 Jestha), Tokha (form 1 to 15 Jestha, exam 23 Jestha), Madhyapur Thimi (form 1 to 10 Jestha, exam 16 Jestha, minimum SEE GPA 1.6), Bharatpur (form 8 to 22 Jestha, institutional schools and community campuses), Pokhara (paper form at Pokhara-17 Damside, 13 to 20 May) plus Itahari and Dhangadhi. Each city runs its own exam, so you can sit several. The usual pattern is a free online form right after SEE results, a 100 question exam on the Class 10 syllabus, then merit lists by subject and school. Do not take admission before the result.

faq_add.q: Is there a government scholarship for IT students or for children of Nepali Army soldiers?
faq_add.a: Yes, two. The Department of Information Technology pays NPR 50,000 once to IT students at the bachelor, master, M.Phil. or PhD level in Nepali universities, on a quota; the 2082 call ran from 12 to 26 May 2025 (doit.gov.np, scholarship@doit.gov.np). The Nepal Army Military Welfare Directorate pays NPR 25,000 a year to one child of a serving or retired soldier in Class 4 to 12, up to age 21, with at least 40 percent in a community school or 50 percent in an institutional school; the 2082 call ran 26 August to 17 October 2026. Neither notice prints a seat count, so they are listed as open calls.
